{{nihongo|'''Ikama Shrine'''|伊河麻神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Suruga Province]].

'''Ikama Shrine''' (いかまじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}, {{ill|Shizuoka (city)|an|Shizuoka|ar|شيزوكا (مدينة)|arz|شيزوكا (مدينه)|ast|Shizuoka|az|Şizuoka|azb|شیزوئوکا|ban|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|be|Сідзуока (горад)|bg|Шидзуока (град)|br|Shizuoka|ca|Shizuoka|ce|Сидзуока (гӀала)|ceb|Shizuoka-shi (distrito)|cs|Šizuoka|da|Shizuoka|de|Shizuoka|eo|Ŝizuoko|es|Shizuoka|et|Shizuoka|eu|Shizuoka|fa|شیزوئوکا|fi|Shizuoka|fj|Shizuoka|fr|Shizuoka|ga|Shizuoka|gl|Shizuoka|he|שיזואוקה|hi|शिज़ूओका|hu|Sizuoka (település)|hy|Սիձուոկա|id|Shizuoka|is|Shizuoka|it|Shizuoka|ja|静岡市|ka|სიძუოკა|ki|Shizuoka|ko|시즈오카시|lt|Šidzuoka (miestas)|lv|Šidzuoka|mdf|Сидзуока (ошсь)|mg|Shizuoka|mn|Шизүока|mr|शिझुओका|ms|Shizuoka|mzn|شیزوئوکا (شهر)|nl|Shizuoka (stad)|no|Shizuoka|os|Сидзуокæ (сахар)|pl|Shizuoka|pms|Shizuoka|pt|Shizuoka (cidade)|ro|Shizuoka|ru|Сидзуока (город)|sah|Сидзуока|sc|Shizuoka|sco|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|sh|Shizuoka|simple|Shizuoka (city)|sk|Šizuoka|sr|Шизуока|su|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|sv|Shizuoka|sw|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|tg|Шизуока|th|ชิซูโอกะ (นคร)|tl|Shizuoka|tok|ma tomo Sisujoka|tr|Şizuoka|tt|Сидзуока (шәһәр)|tum|Shizuoka|uk|Сідзуока|ur|شیزوکا|uz|Shizuoka|vep|Sidzuok (lidn)|vi|Shizuoka (thành phố)|war|Shizuoka (syudad)|wuu|静冈市|zh|靜岡市|zh_classical|靜岡市|zh_min_nan|Sizuoka-chhī|zh_yue|靜岡市|qid=Q174691}}, {{ill|Suruga-ku, Shizuoka|ar|سوروغا-كو|ceb|Suruga Ku|fa|سوروگا-کو، نیگاتا|fr|Suruga-ku|id|Suruga-ku, Shizuoka|it|Suruga-ku|ja|駿河区|ko|스루가구|tr|Suruga (semt)|uk|Район Суруґа|ur|سوروگا وارڈ، شیزوکا|zh|駿河區|qid=Q1042630}}. It is the Fourth Shrine (Shinomiya) among the former “Five Shrines” of {{ill|Suruga Province|ckb|پارێزگای سروگا|cs|Provincie Suruga|de|Provinz Suruga|eo|Provinco Suruga|es|Provincia de Suruga|fa|ولایت سوروگا|fr|Province de Suruga|gl|Provincia de Suruga|hak|Suruga-koet|id|Provinsi Suruga|it|Suruga (provincia)|ja|駿河国|ko|스루가국|lt|Surugos žemė|nl|Suruga (provincie)|pt|Província de Suruga|ru|Суруга (провинция)|simple|Suruga Province|sk|Suruga (provincia)|sr|Провинција Суруга|th|แคว้นซูรูงะ|tr|Suruga (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Суруґа|vi|Tỉnh Suruga|zh|駿河國|zh_min_nan|Suruga-kok|zh_yue|駿河國|qid=Q864170}}.

The Five Shrines, according to the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, are {{ill|Fujisan Hongū Sengen Taisha|fa|فوجیسان هونگو سنگن تایشا|fr|Fujisan Hongū Sengen-taisha|id|Fujisan Hongū Sengen Taisha|ja|富士山本宮浅間大社|nl|Fujisan Hongū Sengen Taisha|zh|富士山本宮淺間大社|qid=Q653180|lt=Fuji Sengen Shrine}} (First Shrine), {{ill|Toyozumi Shrine|ja|豊積神社|qid=Q18337536}} (Second Shrine), {{ill|Miho Shrine (Q11489249)|ja|御穂神社|qid=Q11489249}} (Third Shrine), '''Ikama Shrine''' (Fourth Shrine), and {{ill|Sakabe Shrine|ja|酒瓶神社|qid=Q119929617}} (Fifth Shrine)<ref>“Kojima Village History,” p.178</ref>.

=== Enshrined Deity ===
* {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|qid=Q317997|lt=Hondawake no Mikoto}}<ref name="#1">Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Association, Shizuoka Branch; Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Parishioners Association, Shizuoka Branch, “Shizuoka City Shrine Directory” (1976), p.127</ref> ({{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}}<ref name="abe">“Abe District, Shizuoka Prefecture Gazetteer,” p.687</ref><ref name="ozato">“Ōsato Village History, Lower Volume (1),” Chapter 7, Shrine and Temple Legends</ref>)

=== History ===
=== Founding ===
April of {{ill|Hakuhō|Q11580612|qid=Q11580612}} 4 (664, or 675)<ref name="abe"/><ref name="ozato"/>

=== General History ===
The Shogun Gunshinkaichō records it as “once a venerable and imposing shrine”<ref name="#1"/>.
Around the {{ill|Eiroku|Q1143341|qid=Q1143341}} era, {{ill|Takeda Shingen|Q276404|qid=Q276404}} is said to have burned it, stating that he would rebuild the structures if he won the battle. However, it was never rebuilt, and the present shrine is said to have been the inner sanctuary (okuiin) of that time<ref name="ozato"/>.

=== Court Rank ===
The Shogun Gunshinkaichō lists it as “Senior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade, Igama Myōjin”<ref name="ozato"/>.

=== Shrine Grounds ===
The following shrines are enshrined within the grounds<ref name="ozato"/>.

* {{ill|Inari shrine|Q514480|qid=Q514480}} (Enshrined deity: {{ill|Ukanomitama|bcl|Ukemochi|ca|Uke Mochi|da|Ogetsu-no-hime|de|Ukemochi|eo|Uke Moĉi|es|Uke Mochi|eu|Ukemochi|fa|اوکه موچی|hr|Uke Mochi|it|Uke-Mochi|ja|保食神|mni|ꯎꯀꯦꯃꯣꯆꯤ|pl|Ukemochi|pt|Ukemochi|ru|Укэмоти-но ками|sl|Uke-moči|sv|Uke-Mochi|uk|Укемоті|zh|保食神|qid=Q2280323|lt=Ukanomitama no Kami}})
* {{ill|Kotohira shrines|Q11646488|qid=Q11646488}} (Enshrined deity: {{ill|Ōmononushi|lt=Ōmononushi|Q10936701|qid=Q10936701|qid=Q10936701|lt=Ōmononushi no Kami}})
* {{ill|Kagu-tsuchi|Q1640658|qid=Q1640658|lt=Hi-ume no Mitama Shrine}} (Enshrined deities: {{ill|Kitchen God|cdo|Cáu-gŭng|de|Zao Jun|es|Zao Shen|fa|خدای آشپزخانه|fi|Zao Jun|fr|Zaowangye|id|Zao Jun|ja|かまど神|jv|Zao Jun|nl|Keukengod|no|Zao Jun|pl|Zao Jun|sv|Zao-Jun|th|เทพเจ้าเตาไฟ|wuu|灶神|za|Cauqvuengz|zh|灶君|zh_min_nan|Chàu-kun|zh_yue|灶君|qid=Q249178|lt=Okutsuhiko no Kami and Okutsuhime no Kami}})

=== Access ===
500 m south of JR {{ill|Shizuoka Station|Q801440|qid=Q801440}}, on the north side of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Nankan Line}} ({{ill|Shizuoka Prefectural Road Route 407|Q11663505|qid=Q11663505|lt=Prefectural Route 407}}).
* Bus stop: “Ikama Shrine”
